title: The Key That Was Never Cut

scenes.text: When the house was cleared in 1974, one drawer was still locked.
scenes.art_prompt: an old wooden desk with a single locked drawer in dusty light, archival

scenes.text: The family had lived there for sixty years. No one knew where the key had gone.
scenes.art_prompt: sepia family photographs on a wall in a dim parlour, aged paper

scenes.text: A locksmith opened it in nine minutes. Inside was a single brass key, unlabelled.
scenes.art_prompt: a brass key resting on faded newspaper inside an open drawer, close up

scenes.text: It did not fit any door in the house. Investigators tested all forty-one of them.
scenes.art_prompt: a row of old interior doors along a long corridor, one key in hand

scenes.text: The key was filed under evidence and never claimed. The drawer, they noted, had been locked from the inside.
scenes.art_prompt: an evidence box on a shelf under cold light, quiet and unresolved

scenes.text: Follow Unsolved Archive for the next file.
scenes.art_prompt: a closed archive room with tall shelves and one lamp, final wide shot
